home.covHeading: Fifteen markets, held to one standard of evidence.
home.covBody: We follow the sectors where companies compete for local demand: consumer goods and retail, financial services, healthcare, logistics, energy, technology and real estate. Every report applies the same structure and the same sourcing rules, so markets can be compared side by side.

home.stageEnterBody: Entry routes, partners, regulation, costs and the economics of the first years.

about.lead: KIRA Research is a research house covering Southeast Asia, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Australia and New Zealand. We help companies, and the teams that advise them, decide where to compete, how to enter and how to grow, with evidence they can cite.
about.purposeHeading: Better evidence for decisions in Asian markets.
about.purposeP1: Asian markets are fragmented, fast-moving and documented in many languages. The evidence a leadership team needs usually exists, but it is spread across local filings, industry bodies, trade press and the experience of people who work in the market.
about.purposeP2: Our work is to bring that evidence together, test it, and turn it into a clear answer to the question being asked: is this market worth pursuing, how should we enter, and where can we grow?
about.purposeP3: We started in company data, built dedicated research desks for Japan, Korea and China, and today publish industry research, expert insight and primary research under one name.
about.journeyHeading: From company data to research partner.
about.journeyLead: Each stage added a capability our research relies on today.
about.j1Body: BizDirect Asia is established as a company intelligence data portal covering more than 15 million companies across 15 Asian countries.
about.j2Body: The Japan Research Desk opens, introducing industry research, expert interviews and business matching.
about.j3Body: Dedicated Korea and China Research Desks open, broadening our research capability across the region.
about.j4Body: The BizDirect Asia Interview Transcripts Database launches, turning insight from real expert interviews into accessible research intelligence.
about.j5Body: Industry research and market intelligence services launch, and BizDirect Asia becomes KIRA Research, completing its evolution into a research-focused intelligence partner.
about.doHeading: Three ways we inform a decision.
about.do1Body: Reports on markets, segments and entry routes, each written around a specific business question, with a source on every figure. Every report is published in English, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.
about.do2Body: Interview transcripts and one-to-one conversations with operators, executives and specialists who know the market first-hand.
about.do3Body: Customer surveys and in-depth interviews run in the local language, for the questions published sources cannot answer.
about.how1Body: Every project starts from the decision it must inform, and gathers the evidence that decision needs.
about.how2Body: Numbers carry their source, estimates are labelled and thin evidence is flagged, so findings can be checked and cited.
about.how3Body: We work from local-language sources and publish in the reader's language, with identical figures and sources in every edition.
about.how4Body: Our research team reviews every report before it is published.
about.whereBody: We focus on sectors where companies compete for local demand, rather than export-only manufacturing, across three sub-regions.
about.regionSeaVal: Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Brunei
about.factLanguagesVal: English · 日本語 · 한국어 · 简体中文
about.closingBody: Read the executive summary of any report, see how our research is made, or tell us about the decision in front of you.

experts.heroSub: Kira Experts arranges conversations with operators, executives, specialists and advisers who have first-hand experience of the markets we cover, matched to the question in front of you.
experts.whatP1: Published research explains a market. People who have worked in it explain how it behaves. Kira Experts gives you direct access to that experience across Southeast Asia, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Australia and New Zealand.
experts.whatP2: Each conversation is arranged around a specific question, so the time is spent on what you need to know.
experts.step1Body: Tell us the market, the sector and what you need to understand. A short brief is enough to begin.
experts.step2Title: We identify and brief the expert
experts.step2Body: We look for a person whose experience fits the question and brief them on what you want to cover.
experts.step3Body: You hold the conversation directly. A written summary of the discussion is available on request.
experts.q1Body: Whether the opportunity is as large in practice as it appears on paper, and what tends to slow new entrants.
experts.q2Body: How rules, licences and approvals are applied in practice, beyond the text of the regulation.
experts.q3Body: Who the credible distributors, partners and intermediaries are, and how relationships with them typically work.
experts.q4Body: How established players respond to new entrants on price, channels and talent.
experts.q5Body: What it realistically costs to operate locally, and how prices are set across the market.
experts.termsCompliance: Experts are engaged for their general knowledge and experience. Kira Experts does not facilitate the disclosure of confidential or material non-public information.
experts.formTitle: Tell us what you need to know.
experts.formSub: Describe the market and the question. We will reply by email to discuss the next step.
experts.briefPlaceholder: The market and sector, the decision you are working on, and what you would like to learn from someone with first-hand experience.
experts.successBody: Thank you. We will review your question and reply by email. To add context in the meantime, write to hello@kiraresearch.com.

experts.in3Body: Numbers carry a marker that links to a dated source. Channel practice is marked separately, so you can see what rests on what.

experts.b2Body: Our analysts bring the conversation up to date with dated sources from the last two years: sales data, regulation, company results and local news.

meth.lead: Our reports are desk research. We work from public and licensed sources, attach a source to every figure, and review each report before publication. This page sets out each step, and its limits.
meth.principle1Body: We work from published and licensed sources rather than fieldwork, surveys or interviews.
meth.principle2Body: Each number shows where it comes from, where it is estimated, and where the evidence is thin.
meth.principle3Body: Every report is reviewed by our research team before it is published.
meth.step1P1: Each report is planned around one decision in one market and one sector. Its stage determines the question: assess (is the market worth pursuing?), enter (how do we get in?) or expand (where does growth come from next?).
meth.step1P2: Topics are drawn from our coverage plan and approved by our team before research begins. The plan sets out the questions the report must answer, and the report is structured to answer them.
meth.step1DetailLabel: What the plan fixes up front
meth.step1Detail1: The stage and the decision the report informs
meth.step1Detail2: The guiding questions each section must answer
meth.step1Detail3: The analyses used to answer them (sizing, competition, entry routes, regulation, costs)
meth.step1Detail4: The scope: market, sector and, where useful, a narrower segment
meth.step2Title: Desk research from public and licensed sources.
meth.step2P1: We gather current data on market size, demand, competitors, regulation and recent deals before each report is written. Sources include government statistics, regulators, company filings and announcements, industry associations, trade and local-language media, and licensed data.
meth.step2P2: Where sources disagree, the report notes it. Where we estimate, the estimate is labelled and its basis shown.
meth.step2Detail1: A source tag on every reported figure
meth.step2Detail2: Local-language sources used for in-country data where available
meth.step2Detail3: Material figures compared across sources where more than one exists
meth.step2Detail4: An explicit "est." label on numbers we model ourselves
meth.step3P1: We use AI tools in our workflow: to search and summarise source material, structure data tables, draft sections against the research plan, and translate between English, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.
meth.step3P2: AI speeds up the work. It does not decide what a number is. Figures must trace back to a tagged source, and anything that cannot be sourced is removed or labelled as an estimate.
meth.step3Detail2: Drafting sections under the research plan
meth.step3Detail3: Building tables and charts from sourced data
meth.step3Detail4: Translating the English edition into Japanese, Korean and Chinese
meth.step4P1: Every report is reviewed by our research team before it goes out. The review checks that figures match their sources, that conclusions follow from the evidence, and that the report answers the questions it set out to answer.
meth.step4P2: Japanese, Korean and Chinese editions are translated from the reviewed English edition. Figures, names and sources stay the same across languages.
meth.step4Detail1: Reported figures checked against their tagged source
meth.step4Detail2: Unsourced claims removed or marked as estimates
meth.step4Detail3: Regulatory and market claims checked for currency
meth.step4Detail5: Final read for clarity and tone
meth.transLead: Desk research is strong in some areas and limited in others. The distinction below indicates when a report can be relied on and when further checks are advisable.
meth.transStrong1: Structured answers to entry questions: size, demand, competitors, regulation and routes to market
meth.transStrong2: Competitive landscapes built from filings, announcements and published data
meth.transStrong3: Traceable figures, each with a source you can check
meth.transStrong4: Consistent structure across countries, so markets can be compared
meth.transLimit1: No primary fieldwork: reports do not draw on interviews, surveys or channel checks, so on-the-ground detail depends on what has been published. First-hand perspective is available separately through Kira Experts.
meth.transLimit2: Forecasts are estimates: directional, not precise to a percentage point
meth.transLimit3: Private company financials are often not public; estimates are clearly marked
meth.transLimit4: Events after the last-refresh date are not covered until the report is refreshed
meth.qa1Body: Every reported number carries a source tag. Untraceable figures do not go out as facts.
meth.qa2Body: Our research team reads the report before publication. Weak claims are sharpened or removed.
meth.qa3Body: Language editions come from the reviewed English edition, with the same figures and sources.
meth.qa4Body: Each report shows its last-refresh date, so you know how current it is.
meth.closingBody: A method matters only if the reports hold up to it. Read any executive summary and judge for yourself.
meth.heroTag: A clear process for credible insights.

survey.heroSub: Kira Survey is primary research in the local market. Our research team designs and runs customer surveys and in-depth interviews in the local language, so you can see how buyers in the market think, choose and decide.
survey.whatP1: Published research tells you how a market is structured. Customers tell you why they buy, what they pay and what they would change. Kira Survey puts that conversation within reach for companies entering or expanding across Southeast Asia, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Australia and New Zealand.
survey.whatP2: Every study starts from the decision you need to make, so the questions, the respondents and the reporting are built around it.
survey.mHeading: Two ways to hear from customers.
survey.m1Body: Structured questionnaires to a defined group of consumers, business buyers or channel partners, in the local language, for results you can compare across segments and markets.
survey.m2Body: One-to-one conversations with customers, buyers and decision-makers that explore the reasons behind behaviour, in the respondent's own words.
survey.m3Body: Interviews to find the right questions, then a survey to measure how widely the answers hold; or the other way round.
survey.step1Body: Tell us the market, the customers you want to hear from and the decision you are weighing. A short brief is enough to begin.
survey.step2Body: We propose the questionnaire or interview guide and the respondent profile, and you approve them before fieldwork starts.
survey.step3Title: We run it in the market
survey.step3Body: We reach respondents who match the profile and carry out the survey or interviews in the local language.
survey.step4Body: A written report with the evidence behind each finding. Interview summaries are available on request.
survey.qHeading: Where asking customers directly matters most.
survey.q1Body: Who influences and who signs off on a purchase, and what they look for before they choose.
survey.q2Body: Where customers see value, how they react to price points, and what they pay today.
survey.q3Body: How customers respond to your product, brand or concept, and what would have to change for this market.
survey.q4Body: How customers find, compare and buy, and which channels they trust.
survey.q5Body: What customers still cannot get from today's suppliers, and where the opening is.
survey.termsStandards: Participation is voluntary. Findings are reported in aggregate or without names, and respondents are not asked for confidential company information.
survey.formTitle: Tell us what you need to hear.
survey.formSub: Describe the market and the question. We will reply by email to discuss the next step.
survey.briefPlaceholder: The market and customer group, the decision you are working on, and what you would like to learn from customers.
survey.successBody: Thank you. We will review your question and reply by email. To add context in the meantime, write to hello@kiraresearch.com.
survey.heroTag: Real customer insights in Southeast Asia and beyond.
